text:
Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond, and Jaeger-LeCoultre's ambassador. Will 007 wear Omega or JLC?

Neither brand has confirmed which watch he'll wear on screen. Pattinson wore no watch in the casting announcement.

Omega has supplied Bond since GoldenEye in 1995. Its Seamaster Diver 300M James Bond Edition (ref. 210.30.42.20.03.004, 42 mm steel) lists at US$8,600 on Omega's US site, checked 21 November 2026.

Omega or Jaeger-LeCoultre on 007? Comment your pick.

Source: Amazon MGM (casting, 16 November 2026); Omega (price, 21 November 2026); Fratello Watches and WatchPro (no watch confirmed; Omega history). Photo: Jaeger-LeCoultre (official press image); watch image: Omega.
